title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids
product: Electric Kettle, Water Boiler, Coffee Maker, Steam Cooker
scope: This standard deals with the safety of electric appliances for heating liquids for household and similar purposes, their rated voltage being not more than 250 V single-phase or 480 V other appliances.

clauses.title: Marking and Instructions
clauses.requirement: Appliances shall be marked with rated voltage (V), rated power input (W), manufacturer name/trademark, model reference, and symbol for nature of supply.

clauses.title: Protection Against Access to Live Parts
clauses.requirement: Appliances shall be constructed and enclosed so that there is adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts using test probe B.

clauses.title: Leakage Current and Electric Strength at Operating Temperature
clauses.requirement: Leakage current shall not exceed 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances. Electric strength test applied at 1000 V AC for basic insulation.

clauses.title: Abnormal Operation - Boil-Dry Test
clauses.requirement: Kettles are operated empty at 1.15 times rated power input until the thermal cut-out operates. No hazard, fire, or emission of molten metal is permitted.

clauses.title: Cordless Kettle Interlock Mechanism
clauses.requirement: Cordless kettles shall incorporate contacts that disconnect supply before the kettle is lifted from its base, preventing live terminal exposure.

clauses.title: Resistance to Heat and Fire
clauses.requirement: Non-metallic parts supporting electrical connections must withstand glow-wire test at 850°C and needle-flame test per IS 11000.

required_tests: Protection Against Access to Live Parts (Test Probe B)
Leakage Current & Dielectric Electric Strength at Operating Temp
Power Input and Current Measurement
Boil-Dry Abnormal Operation Test
Thermal Cut-Out Cycle Endurance Test
Spill-Over Moisture Resistance Test
Glow-Wire Test (850°C) for Fire Resistance

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
product: Packaged Drinking Water, Bottled Water, 20L Water Jars, Water Pouches
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and testing for packaged drinking water (other than packaged natural mineral water) offered for direct consumption.
qco_reference: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare Notification & Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations

clauses.title: Treatment Technologies
clauses.requirement: Water shall be derived from surface, ground or municipal source and subjected to filtration, aeration, demineralization, RO, and disinfection by UV/Ozonation.

clauses.title: Physical and Sensory Requirements
clauses.requirement: TDS max 500 mg/L, Turbidity max 2 NTU, pH range 6.5 to 8.5, Odour unobjectionable, Taste agreeable.

clauses.title: Chemical Requirements & Toxic Substances
clauses.requirement: Lead max 0.01 mg/L, Arsenic max 0.01 mg/L, Cadmium max 0.003 mg/L, Mercury max 0.001 mg/L, Nitrate max 45 mg/L.

clauses.title: Microbiological Requirements
clauses.requirement: Escherichia coli: Absent in 250 ml; Coliform bacteria: Absent in 250 ml; Faecal streptococci: Absent in 250 ml; Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Absent in 250 ml; Yeast & Mould: Absent.

clauses.title: Packaging Materials
clauses.requirement: Shall be packed in food-grade plastic containers conforming to IS 15410 or glass containers conforming to IS 13983.

required_tests: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) and pH Level
Heavy Metals: Lead, Arsenic, Cadmium, Mercury via ICP-MS
Pesticide Residue Analysis (Individual max 0.0001 mg/L)
Microbiological Testing: E. Coli, Coliforms, Pseudomonas Aeruginosa
Radioactive Contaminants: Alpha and Beta activity
Packaging Migration Test per IS 9845

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
product: Children Toys, Plastic Toys, Educational Toys, Plush Toys, Ride-on Toys
scope: Applies to all toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age. Specifies requirements and test methods for mechanical and physical properties including small parts and sharp edges.

clauses.title: Small Parts for Children Under 36 Months
clauses.requirement: Toys and removable parts must not fit completely into the small parts cylinder (31.7 mm diameter) to eliminate choking hazards.

clauses.title: Sharp Edges and Points
clauses.requirement: Accessible edges of toys shall not possess sharp burrs or glass/metal edges as assessed by the sharp edge tester.

clauses.title: Folding Mechanisms and Hinges
clauses.requirement: Toy pushchairs, prams, and folding toys must have locking devices to prevent accidental collapse.

clauses.title: Drop and Impact Resistance Test
clauses.requirement: Toy subjected to 5 drops from 850 mm onto steel plate without releasing hazardous small parts or sharp projections.

required_tests: Small Parts Cylinder Choking Hazard Test (under 36 months)
Sharp Edges and Accessible Points Verification
Drop and Impact Resistance Mechanical Test
Tension and Torque Test for Detachable Parts
Heavy Element Migration Test (Lead, Cadmium per IS 9873 Part 3)
Flammability Rate Assessment per IS 9873 Part 2

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification (Fifth Revision)
product: Domestic Pressure Cooker, Aluminium Pressure Cooker, Stainless Steel Cooker
scope: Prescribes requirements for domestic pressure cookers intended for cooking food under pressure using heat from gas stoves, induction, electricity, or solid fuels.

clauses.title: Material of Body and Lid
clauses.requirement: Aluminium alloy conforming to IS 21 or stainless steel conforming to grade 304 (04Cr18Ni10) of IS 6911.

clauses.title: Nominal Capacity and Proof Pressure
clauses.requirement: Cookers shall withstand hydrostatic test pressure of 200 kPa (2.0 kgf/cm²) without leakage or permanent deformation.

clauses.title: Safety Devices - Weight Valve & Safety Valve
clauses.requirement: Every pressure cooker must feature an operating pressure regulating device (vent weight) and a secondary fusible metallic safety plug.

clauses.title: Gasket Release System (GRS)
clauses.requirement: Lid shall incorporate a controlled gasket release aperture that vents steam safely downward if both primary and secondary valves clog.

clauses.title: Burst Pressure Test
clauses.requirement: The pressure cooker body must withstand a minimum hydrostatic pressure of 300 kPa (3.0 bar) without bursting.

required_tests: Hydrostatic Proof Pressure Test at 200 kPa
Bursting Pressure Test (minimum 300 kPa)
Safety Valve Fusible Plug Release Temperature Verification
Gasket Release System (GRS) Operation under Blocked Nozzle
Handle Thermal Insulation and Impact Strength Test
Cooker Internal Volume and Working Pressure Verification

title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification
product: Motorcycle Helmet, Two Wheeler Helmet, Full Face Helmet, Open Face Helmet
scope: Specifies requirements regarding construction, finish, mass, test methods, and performance for protective helmets intended for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.
committee: TED 26 - Automotive Safety and Crash Protection
qco_reference: Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (MoRTH)

clauses.title: Maximum Weight Limit
clauses.requirement: The maximum weight of the complete helmet with visor and all accessories shall not exceed 1.2 kg.

clauses.title: Impact Energy Attenuation Test
clauses.requirement: Impacted against flat and hemispherical steel anvils at 7.5 m/s drop speed. Peak headform acceleration shall not exceed 300g (HIC <= 2400).

clauses.title: Penetration Resistance
clauses.requirement: A 3 kg conical metal striker dropped from 1 metre shall not make electrical contact with the headform.

clauses.title: Retention System (Chin Strap) Strength
clauses.requirement: Subjected to dynamic drop test and static tensile load of 1500 N; maximum elongation must not exceed 25 mm.

clauses.title: Visor Optical & Mechanical Properties
clauses.requirement: Luminous transmittance minimum 85% for clear visors; shatter-proof polycarbonate tested against high-speed projectile impact.

required_tests: Impact Attenuation Test (Flat & Hemispherical Anvil)
Penetration Resistance Test (3 kg Striker)
Retention System Strength and Dynamic Slippage Test
Visor Optical Clarity and Abrasion Resistance Test
Rigidity and Lateral Deformation Test
Conditioning Exposure: High Heat (+50°C), Cold (-10°C), Water Immersion

title: Sports Footwear - Part 1: General Purpose
product: Sports Shoes, Running Shoes, Walking Shoes, Athletic Footwear
scope: Prescribes requirements, methods of sampling, and test for sports footwear intended for general fitness, athletic, and jogging activities.
qco_reference: Footwear Made from Leather and Other Materials (Quality Control) Order, 2024

clauses.title: Upper Material Properties
clauses.requirement: Tensile strength of textile/synthetic upper min 15 N/mm²; tear strength min 40 N; breathability min 0.8 mg/cm²·h.

clauses.title: Outsole Flexing Resistance
clauses.requirement: Bennewart flex test: Outsole must withstand 30,000 cycles with cut growth not exceeding 4.0 mm.

clauses.title: Abrasion Resistance of Sole
clauses.requirement: Relative volume loss under DIN abrasion cylinder test shall not exceed 150 mm³ for density >= 0.9 g/cm³.

clauses.title: Upper-to-Sole Bond Strength
clauses.requirement: Peel adhesion strength between upper and sole must be at least 4.0 N/mm or material tear.

required_tests: Sole Flexing Resistance (Bennewart Flex 30,000 cycles)
Outsole Abrasion Resistance Test (DIN Abrasion)
Upper to Sole Bond Adhesion Strength
Heel Energy Absorption Test
Tear Strength and Tensile Strength of Upper
Slip Resistance Coefficient Test

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
product: TMT Rebars, Steel Reinforcement Bars, Fe 500D, Fe 550D, Concrete Reinforcing Steel
scope: Covers requirements for deformed steel bars and wires produced by thermo-mechanical treatment (TMT) or cold-working for use as reinforcement in concrete.
qco_reference: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (Ministry of Steel)

clauses.title: Chemical Composition Limits
clauses.requirement: For Fe 500D: Carbon max 0.25%, Sulphur max 0.040%, Phosphorus max 0.040%, S+P max 0.075%, Carbon Equivalent max 0.42%.

clauses.title: Tensile and Yield Strength Requirements
clauses.requirement: Fe 500D: 0.2% Proof Stress min 500 N/mm²; Tensile Strength min 565 N/mm²; TS/YS ratio min 1.10; Elongation min 16.0%.

clauses.title: Bend and Rebend Test
clauses.requirement: Bars must withstand 180° cold bend around mandrel without crack or rupture; rebend test after boiling at 100°C for 30 minutes.

clauses.title: Nominal Mass Tolerances
clauses.requirement: Cross-sectional weight tolerance: ±7% for dia <= 10mm, ±5% for dia 10-16mm, ±3% for dia > 16mm.

required_tests: Chemical Analysis: Carbon, Sulphur, Phosphorus via Optical Emission Spectrometer
Tensile Proof Stress (0.2% offset) and Ultimate Tensile Strength
Percentage Elongation and Total Elongation at Maximum Force (Agt)
180 Degree Cold Bend Test and Reverse Rebend Test
Nominal Weight per Metre Measurement
Transverse and Longitudinal Rib Geometry and Spacing Verification

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (Sixth Revision)
product: OPC Cement, OPC 33, OPC 43, OPC 53 Grade Cement
scope: Covers manufacture, chemical, and physical requirements for Ordinary Portland Cement of 33 grade, 43 grade, and 53 grade.

clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
clauses.requirement: Ratio of percentage of lime to percentages of silica, alumina and iron oxide (LSF) shall be 0.66 to 1.02. Insoluble residue max 5.0%, Magnesia max 6.0%.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength Requirements
clauses.requirement: OPC 53 Grade: 72±1 h compressive strength min 27 MPa; 168±2 h min 37 MPa; 672±4 h (28 days) min 53 MPa.

clauses.title: Setting Time
clauses.requirement: Initial setting time not less than 30 minutes; Final setting time not more than 600 minutes via Vicat apparatus.

clauses.title: Soundness Test
clauses.requirement: Unaffected by Le Chatelier expansion exceeding 10 mm and Autoclave expansion exceeding 0.8%.

required_tests: Compressive Strength at 3 Days, 7 Days, and 28 Days
Initial and Final Setting Time via Vicat Needle
Le Chatelier and Autoclave Soundness Determination
Fineness by Blaine Air Permeability Apparatus (min 225 m²/kg)
Chemical Loss on Ignition (LOI) and Insoluble Residue Analysis
Sulphuric Anhydride (SO3) Content Determination

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
product: Gold Jewellery, Gold Coins, Gold Bangles, Chains, Rings, Bullion
scope: Specifies fineness grades of gold alloys used for manufacture of jewellery/artefacts, and details official marking requirements including the BIS Logo, Purity, and 6-digit HUID.
qco_reference: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020 & 2026 Amendments

clauses.title: Recognized Karatage and Fineness Grades
clauses.requirement: Permitted standards: 24K (999 parts per thousand), 23K (958), 22K (916), 20K (833), 18K (750), 14K (585), and 9K (375).

clauses.title: Official Three-Mark Hallmarking System
clauses.requirement: Every piece of hallmarked jewellery must bear: (1) BIS Standard Mark triangular crest; (2) Purity in karat and fineness (e.g. 22K916); (3) 6-digit alphanumeric HUID.

clauses.title: HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification)
clauses.requirement: Unique laser-engraved 6-character identifier (e.g. 'AB1234') generated by the central BIS Hallmarking portal at recognized A&H Centres.

clauses.title: Fire Assay Testing Method
clauses.requirement: Gold purity determination shall be performed in accordance with IS 1418 using cupellation and fire assaying method with accuracy ±0.5 parts per thousand.

required_tests: X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) Preliminary Non-Destructive Screening
Cupellation & Fire Assay Chemical Verification (per IS 1418)
Touchstone Comparative Verification
Laser Inscription Integrity and Legibility Verification
Soldering Alloy Purity and Lead/Cadmium Free Certification

title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
product: Silver Jewellery, Silver Utensils, Silver Coins, Silver Artefacts
scope: Specifies fineness grades of silver and silver alloys used in the manufacture of jewellery/artefacts and marking guidelines under voluntary and notified hallmarking.
qco_reference: Voluntary Silver Hallmarking Notification (Consumer Protection Guidelines)

clauses.title: Silver Fineness Grades
clauses.requirement: Standard silver grades recognized: 999 (fine silver), 970, 925 (Sterling Silver), 900, 835, and 800 parts per thousand.

clauses.title: Silver Hallmark Marks
clauses.requirement: Bears BIS mark, fineness grade number (e.g. 925), Assaying centre identification mark, and registered jeweller's identification mark.

required_tests: Volumetric (Potentiometric) Silver Titration per IS 2113
XRF Spectrometry Screening
Gravimetric Chloride Precipitation Test
